Name: qxtProviderServiceHours
Sql:
TRANSFORM Sum(csp.HoursPerWeek) AS TotalHours
SELECT p.ProviderName
FROM tblServices AS s INNER JOIN (tblProviders AS p INNER JOIN (tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn INNER JOIN (tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc INNER JOIN tblClientServicePlan AS csp ON psc.ProviderServiceCatalogID = csp.ProviderServiceCatalogID) ON csn.ClientServiceNeedID = csp.ClientServiceNeedID) ON p.ProviderID = psc.ProviderID) ON s.ServiceID = csn.ServiceID
WHERE (((csp.FiscalYear)=GetCurrentFiscalYear()))
GROUP BY p.ProviderName
PIVOT s.ServiceName;
